scope: Raphael opening and tutorial-choice handoff in Lisbon
editorial_policy: Translate from the clean Japanese and continuous scene context.
Preserve the five user-accepted opening boxes verbatim.
Do not shorten prose for allocation, renderer, parity, or relocation constraints.
Do not add manual line breaks, control tokens, padding, or speaker bytes.
Technical integration and runtime validation are separate later steps.

records.speaker: Claudio Manaus
records.natural_english: Come on, come on. You'll see when we get there.

records.speaker: Claudio Manaus
records.natural_english: By the way, Raphael... what do you think of men of the sea?

records.speaker: Raphael Castor
records.natural_english: Hmm... what do I think? I'm not really sure...

records.speaker: Claudio Manaus
records.natural_english: What are you talking about? Prince Henry, Duke Leon... man! They're so cool!

records.speaker: Claudio Manaus
records.natural_english: The sea really is a man's greatest adventure!

records.speaker: Raphael Castor
records.natural_english: Here he goes again...

records.speaker: Raphael Castor
records.natural_english: That's all well and good, but how are we supposed to go to sea without a ship?

records.speaker: Claudio Manaus
records.natural_english: You don't have a romantic bone in your body! Come on, a man's allowed to dream!

records.speaker: Claudio Manaus
records.natural_english: And... we're here!

records.speaker: Janus Pasar
records.natural_english: Ah, there you are...

records.speaker: Raphael Castor
records.natural_english: A ship...

records.speaker: Claudio Manaus
records.natural_english: Well? Surprised? We've even named her. Behold: the Carteira!

records.speaker: Claudio Manaus
records.natural_english: She was practically scrap when we found her. Janus and I fixed her up.

records.speaker: Claudio Manaus
records.natural_english: We can't set sail just yet... but someday, once we've saved enough money, we will.

records.speaker: Raphael Castor
records.natural_english: Let's go...

records.speaker: Janus Pasar
records.natural_english: What?

records.speaker: Claudio Manaus
records.natural_english: Huh?

records.speaker: Raphael Castor
records.natural_english: You said it yourself, Claudio. We're going to sea! If money's the problem, Julio might lend us what we need!

records.speaker: Raphael Castor
records.natural_english: I'm going to Julio's place right now!

records.speaker: Claudio Manaus
records.natural_english: Hey, Raphael!

records.speaker: Raphael Castor
records.natural_english: Janus, Claudio, keep working on the repairs! I'm counting on you!

records.speaker: Claudio Manaus
records.natural_english: Hey! Wait up, Raphael!

records.speaker: Claudio Manaus
records.natural_english: Would you look at that... Now he's the most excited one of us!

records.speaker: Janus Pasar
records.natural_english: Looks like he picked up your habit of charging ahead. Once he makes up his mind, he can't sit still.

records.speaker: Claudio Manaus
records.natural_english: He's always been like that. You just don't usually see it. How are the repairs coming along?

records.speaker: Janus Pasar
records.natural_english: The repairs are mostly finished. Though, to be honest, I did nearly all the work...

records.speaker: Claudio Manaus
records.natural_english: Come on, don't sweat the small stuff. You were enjoying every minute of it.

records.speaker: Janus Pasar
records.natural_english: Ha, you're right. Shall we head over to Julio's place too?

records.speaker: Claudio Manaus
records.natural_english: Yeah. I've got to be there for Raphael.

records.speaker: Janus Pasar
records.natural_english: Yes, yes, I heard you. Let's get going.

records.speaker: Julio Erneco
records.natural_english: What?! Another advance, Claudio? Absolutely not! What are you planning to waste it on this time?

records.speaker: Claudio Manaus
records.natural_english: Don't start yelling before we've even said anything, old man!

records.speaker: Raphael Castor
records.natural_english: I'm sorry. I know it's a lot to ask.

records.speaker: Julio Erneco
records.natural_english: Ah, you're the Castor boy, aren't you?

records.speaker: Raphael Castor
records.natural_english: Forgive us for barging in like this.

records.speaker: Claudio Manaus
records.natural_english: I told you, this isn't like the other times. We're serious! Stop being such a miser and lend us the money already!

records.speaker: Julio Erneco
records.natural_english: I've never seen you do an honest day's work. And now you expect me to trust you? Don't be ridiculous.

records.speaker: Janus Pasar
records.natural_english: Well... you do reap what you sow.

records.speaker: Claudio Manaus
records.natural_english: Grr...

records.speaker: Raphael Castor
records.natural_english: Please, Julio! This was my idea! Is there nothing I can say to change your mind?

records.speaker: Julio Erneco
records.natural_english: Hmm... This is a great deal of money. Even if you're the one asking, Raphael... What does your father think?

records.speaker: Raphael Castor
records.natural_english: I don't want to rely on my father. Not for this. I promise we'll repay every coin. Please, Julio!

records.speaker: Julio Erneco
records.natural_english: I admire your desire to stand on your own. I understand your determination, but...

records.speaker: Claudio Manaus
records.natural_english: Fine! Forget we asked. Come on, Raphael, Janus. We're leaving.

records.speaker: Janus Pasar
records.natural_english: Yes, yes, I'm coming. Stop dragging me.

records.speaker: Raphael Castor
records.natural_english: I'm sorry for asking so much of you. Please excuse us.

records.speaker: Claudio Manaus
records.natural_english: Well... that sounded good, but what are we going to do now?

records.speaker: Janus Pasar
records.natural_english: Raphael, why won't you ask your father?

records.speaker: Raphael Castor
records.natural_english: My father still treats me like a child. He'd never agree to let me go to sea.

records.speaker: Raphael Castor
records.natural_english: If I don't do something now, nothing will ever change!

records.speaker: Claudio Manaus
records.natural_english: That's the spirit, Raphael! Now that's what I call a real man!

records.speaker: Janus Pasar
records.natural_english: It's a fine sentiment, but we still need money. Courage alone won't pay for a voyage.

records.speaker: Claudio Manaus
records.natural_english: Don't spoil the moment... Guess we'll have to start from scratch and earn it ourselves.

records.speaker: Julio Erneco
records.natural_english: Heeey!

records.speaker: Raphael Castor
records.natural_english: That's Julio. What does he want?

records.speaker: Julio Erneco
records.natural_english: You're still here! Good, good.

records.speaker: Janus Pasar
records.natural_english: What is it?

records.speaker: Julio Erneco
records.natural_english: I've given the matter a great deal of thought...

records.speaker: Claudio Manaus
records.natural_english: Out with it already, old man!

records.speaker: Julio Erneco
records.natural_english: Very well. Raphael, take this.

records.speaker: Raphael Castor
records.natural_english: What?! This is...!

records.speaker: System
records.natural_english: You received 30,000 gold coins!

records.speaker: Julio Erneco
records.natural_english: Now that the money's yours, I expect every coin back - with interest.

records.speaker: Raphael Castor
records.natural_english: Y-yes! We'll work hard!

records.speaker: Julio Erneco
records.natural_english: Still, I can't help worrying about what will become of my money. So I've decided to come along and keep an eye on you.

records.speaker: Julio Erneco
records.natural_english: Don't you understand? I'm saying I'll sail with you.

records.speaker: Raphael Castor
records.natural_english: Really?!

records.speaker: Janus Pasar
records.natural_english: A veteran navigator joining us? That certainly puts my mind at ease.

records.speaker: Julio Erneco
records.natural_english: Veteran, you say? You'll make me blush. Though I admit, I've been away from the sea for a while...

records.speaker: Claudio Manaus
records.natural_english: Huh. Is this old man really going to be any use?

records.speaker: Janus Pasar
records.natural_english: That's enough, Claudio. Julio is a renowned navigator.

records.speaker: Julio Erneco
records.natural_english: And that brings us to you, Raphael. You'll be captain of this ship.

records.speaker: Raphael Castor
records.natural_english: Me?! But Janus and Claudio are the ones who rebuilt her...

records.speaker: Julio Erneco
records.natural_english: I'm lending this money because I trust Raphael Castor, the head of Castor Co. That makes you responsible for it.

records.speaker: Raphael Castor
records.natural_english: Castor Co.?! And you want me to lead it?

records.speaker: Julio Erneco
records.natural_english: You're planning to make a name for yourself on seas filled with the world's greatest navigators, aren't you? Then you'll need that kind of ambition.

records.speaker: Julio Erneco
records.natural_english: In other words, Raphael Castor will captain this ship, command the fleet, and lead Castor Co.

records.speaker: Julio Erneco
records.natural_english: Unless you'd rather put Claudio in charge. Of course, if anything went wrong, he'd spend the rest of his life working off the debt...

records.speaker: Julio Erneco
records.natural_english: Still interested, Claudio?

records.speaker: Claudio Manaus
records.natural_english: N-no, thanks! Raphael's the man for the job. Right, Janus?

records.speaker: Janus Pasar
records.natural_english: Agreed. I'm hardly suited to leading a company myself.

records.speaker: Raphael Castor
records.natural_english: B-but...

records.speaker: Julio Erneco
records.natural_english: Just give it your best. That's all I ask.

records.speaker: Raphael Castor
records.natural_english: All right. I'll do it!

records.speaker: Julio Erneco
records.natural_english: Good. That puts my mind at ease. Use this money as the starting capital for your company.

records.speaker: Raphael Castor
records.natural_english: Thank you! I won't waste a single coin!

records.speaker: Janus Pasar
records.natural_english: We truly can't thank you enough, Julio.

records.speaker: Claudio Manaus
records.natural_english: Not bad, old man! I guess you do have a decent side.

records.speaker: Julio Erneco
records.natural_english: Listen to you, acting so high and mighty, you young pup!

records.speaker: Claudio Manaus
records.natural_english: What'd you say, you old fossil? I was paying you a compliment!

records.speaker: Julio Erneco
records.natural_english: It seems you'll need a little pain before you learn to appreciate my greatness.

records.speaker: Claudio Manaus
records.natural_english: Oh yeah? You want a fight?

records.speaker: Julio Erneco
records.natural_english: Heh heh heh! I'm not so old that a pup like you can beat me!

records.speaker: Raphael Castor
records.natural_english: Stop it, both of you!

records.speaker: Julio Erneco
records.natural_english: Not a chance! I won't be satisfied until I've knocked some sense into this fool!

records.speaker: Claudio Manaus
records.natural_english: Is that so? You really want me to break those fingers of yours?

records.speaker: Raphael Castor
records.natural_english: That's enough! As captain, I order you both to stop fighting!

records.speaker: Claudio Manaus
records.natural_english: Aye, Captain! If you say so!

records.speaker: Julio Erneco
records.natural_english: Aye, Captain! If you say so!

records.speaker: Claudio Manaus
records.natural_english: Hey! Don't copy me, old man!

records.speaker: Julio Erneco
records.natural_english: Hmph! As if I'd imitate the likes of you.

records.speaker: Janus Pasar
records.natural_english: What a pair...

records.speaker: Julio Erneco
records.natural_english: Now then, ignore that fool. A voyage succeeds or fails by its preparation, so let's gather everything we'll need.

records.speaker: Julio Erneco
records.natural_english: There is a great deal to learn, so stay close and pay attention.

records.speaker: Raphael Castor
records.natural_english: Yes! Please teach me!

records.speaker: Claudio Manaus
records.natural_english: Tch. He knows a little about ships, and suddenly he thinks he's Raphael's teacher.

records.speaker: Janus Pasar
records.natural_english: All right, that's enough out of you. Let's go.

records.speaker: Janus Pasar
records.natural_english: Let's begin preparing for the voyage.

records.speaker: Janus Pasar
records.natural_english: Would you like Julio to show you what to do, or would you rather prepare on your own?

records.speaker: Choice
records.natural_english: Ask Julio to teach me.

records.speaker: Choice
records.natural_english: I'll prepare on my own.

records.speaker: Julio Erneco
records.natural_english: Very well. Let's get started. First, we'll visit the trading post.

records.speaker: Julio Erneco
records.natural_english: Whenever you enter a town, make a point of visiting the trading post, tavern, and square before you set sail.

records.speaker: Julio Erneco
records.natural_english: That's what I like to hear! Go on, then. Do your best out there.
